Cash Bids Futures Grain Policy On-Farm Pickup Grain Team
Our Grain Team has one goal everyday: to get our producers the best price for their grain.
As a cooperative owned by farmers, our interests are closely aligned with yours. We work for you, and want you to succeed by marketing your crops at the best possible prices. We are here to give you the best possible advice and to assist you in navigating the markets ups and downs, twists and turns, day in and day out.
Grain Policy
Our Grain Policy is updated annually to ensure that we are staying competitive within the market.
Read Our Grain Policy
ON-FARM PICKUP SERVICE
DO YOU HAVE GRAIN THAT NEEDS TO GET TO THE ELEVATOR?
DON’T HAVE TIME OR THE EQUIPMENT TO GET YOUR BUSHELS MOVED QUICKLY AND ECONOMICALLY?
Your cooperative can help. With our On-Farm pickup service, we’ll come to your location and haul your grain to the elevator. Whether you’re, prepping bins for harvest, already in the field or just need your grain moved, we’ll handle the logistics for you throughout the year.
Contact your local Grain Advisor today to learn more.
Contact one of our Grain Team Members : 641-715-1206
The goal of the Nexus Grain Team is to help producers maximize their profit with the least amount of risk exposure possible. Contact one of our experienced Grain Team Members below to start marketing your grain with Nexus today.
